World events, ambient villagers and later schedules

Small server-owned zone events create shared activity without requiring an ecosystem simulator. Ambient villagers/fishers can animate locally; schedules that change service availability require authoritative time and recovery rules.

Scope and player interaction

Small server-owned zone events create shared activity without requiring an ecosystem simulator. Ambient villagers/fishers can animate locally; schedules that change service availability require authoritative time and recovery rules.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase20committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Inactive → Scheduled → Active → Resolving → Completed → Cooldown → Canceled

WBP_Notifications observes results from URPGWorldEventComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Event_Riverwatch. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
WorldEventId and CycleId: unique reward namespace
Start/EndServerTime, phase and revision
ParticipationEntitlements: verified character actions, not simply UI presence
EventSpawn/ResourceModifiers: bounded authored changes
NPCScheduleId and TimeBuckets: optional later content; service fallback location
RewardClaimId: unique character/event/cycle key

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGWorldEventComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_NotificationsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
StartWorldEvent(EventId, CycleId) -> Active|AlreadyActive|Disabled
RecordEventParticipation(VerifiedEvent) -> Counted|Duplicate
ResolveWorldEvent(CycleId) -> ResultReceipts|Pending
ApplyNPCSchedule(TimeBucket) -> DestinationRoleState|Blocked; server for meaningful movement/services

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Server time/controller selects a permitted event cycle and records start/end/phase.
  2. Event spawns bounded encounters or requests deliveries through existing systems; it does not implement separate loot/inventory rules.
  3. Verified participation events create eligibility; completion grants rewards once per cycle through the common transaction service.
  4. Clients receive phase/timer/marker cues and ambient effects. Late joiners see current state, not a history of reward notifications.
  5. On restart resume/cancel the recorded cycle under policy without creating a new reward cycle implicitly.
  6. Later NPC schedules move via navigation to authored locations; critical services keep a fallback contact/location so day/night does not strand progression.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author Riverwatch event: defend the road warning post and deliver repair supplies. Reuse encounter/quest/item definitions with event-cycle context.
  2. Place BP_WorldEventController and NPC_AmbientFisher, a nonrewarding ambient visual actor unless explicitly promoted to a service.
  3. Bind notification/map/quest UI to event phase and server time.
  4. Create schedule table with Day/Night location IDs only after path/door/streaming tests; keep scheduling disabled in the first implementation.
  5. Test overlapping event/resource quotas and restart at resolving phase.

Reopen Phase20 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / Event_Riverwatch / NPC_AmbientFisher. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Replay participation/reward -> one count/grant.
Server restarts -> same cycle or explicit canceled result, not a fresh farmable reward.
Scheduled NPC path blocked -> fallback service remains accessible; no teleport through players/geometry.
Ambient animation notify -> no fish/items spawned into economy.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

One small event per initial zone and 15-minute active duration are proposals. Full ecological/geopolitical simulation is out of scope.

Log cycle/phase/participation and spawn quotas. Event objectives have readable text and clear opt-in context; no mandatory audio-only alarms.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
